proof.definition:
n. any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something
n. a formal series of statements showing that if one thing is true something else necessarily follows from it
n. a measure of alcoholic strength expressed as an integer twice the percentage of alcohol present (by volume)
n. (printing) an impression made to check for errors
proof.translation:
n. 证据, 证明, 试验, 检验, 考验
a. 不能透入的, 证明用的, 防...的, 耐...的
vt. 检验, 试验, 校对, 使不被穿透
[计] 审稿

proof beyond a reasonable doubt.translation: [经] 超过合理怀疑的证明

proof by contradiction.translation: [计] 矛盾证明, 反证法

proof mark.translation:
[计] 验证标记
[经] 验讫记号

proof method.translation: [计] 验证法, 证明方法

proof of death.translation: [法] 死亡验证, 死亡证明

proof of will.translation: [法] 遗嘱证明, 遗嘱认证

proof procedure.translation: [计] 验证过程, 证明过程

proof reading.translation:
[计] 校样, 校对
[经] 校对

proof rule.translation: [计] 验证规则, 校对规则

proof scheme.translation: [计] 验证电路, 验证方案

proof strength.translation: [化] 允许强度; 保证强度

proof technique.translation: [计] 验证技术, 验证方法

proof test.translation: [化] 安全试验; 验证试验

proof time.translation: [计] 验证时间, 校对时间

proof-readers.translation: (proof-reader 的复数) n. 校对员

proof-spirit.translation: [医] 规定酒精, 标准酒精

proofed.definition:
v make or take a proof of, such as a photographic negative, an etching, or typeset
v knead to reach proper lightness
v read for errors
v activate by mixing with water and sometimes sugar or milk
v make resistant (to harm)
s treated so as to become resistant
proofed.translation: vt. 给（织物）做防护处理, 使防水（proof的过去式与过去分词形式）

proofer.definition: s (used in combination or as a suffix) able to withstand

proofers.definition:
plural of proofer
s (used in combination or as a suffix) able to withstand
proofers.translation: (proofer 的复数) n. 印校样的人, 发面工人, 发面机

proofless.definition:
a. Wanting sufficient evidence to induce belief; not
   proved.

prooflike.translation: a. 表面光亮似新铸样币的

proofreaders.definition: n. someone who reads proof in order to find errors and mark corrections
proofreaders.translation: n. 校对者, 校对员

proofreading.translation: v. 校对, 校勘( proofread的现在分词 ); 做校对工作; 校读

proofreads.translation: v. 校对, 校勘( proofread的第三人称单数 ); 做校对工作

proofs.definition:
n any factual evidence that helps to establish the truth of something

n a measure of alcoholic strength expressed as an integer twice the percentage of alcohol present (by volume)
n (printing) an impression made to check for errors

proostracum.definition:
n. The anterior prolongation of the guard of the
   phragmocone of belemnites and allied fossil cephalopods, whether horny
   or calcareous. See Illust. of Phragmocone.

prootic.definition:
a. In front of the auditory capsule; -- applied especially to
   a bone, or center of ossification, in the periotic capsule.
n. A prootic bone.
